question: Que fait l'homme ?
notes: Phrase 1: English 'to smile at the camera', but in the boxed frames the woman looks down at her wrist almost all the time and smiles into the camera only in the last second; 'tendre le bras' is what she does in most boxed frames (she holds her arm out to the man).
